{"total_lines": 42, "text": "1: # Acceptance contract and provenance
2: 
3: This document was added during the November 4, 2026 readiness work, after the
4: port existed. It consolidates existing checks and adds loop verification; it
5: is not evidence that criteria were specified before implementation. Existing
6: browser/audio acceptance checks are unchanged. Changes to those checks remain
7: human-owned and must be separately justified in artifacts/.
8: 
9: ## Automated port scope
10: 
11: Emscripten 4.0.18 must build the supplied engine and shareware WAD. The existing
12: `tests/test_browser.py`, `tests/browser.mjs`, and `tests/test_audio.py` must pass:
13: WAD/Wasm loading, visible framebuffer, new-game/menu navigation, ongoing
14: simulation, movement, turning, ammunition consumed by firing, nonzero effects
15: and music samples, volume/mute, use-key delivery/release, synthetic blur release,
16: alternate movement keys, weapons, automap and pause/resume. Fatal browser/network
17: errors fail the run. The music parser must accept all 13 scores, reject malformed
18: or truncated data and defer audio initialization until a gesture.
19: 
20: A role PASS concerns this automated scope, not the whole assignment. Actual
21: door/switch activation, OS focus transitions, physical speakers, musical fidelity,
22: save persistence and mouse aiming are not established by these checks. A manual
23: playthrough remains separate evidence. Do not invent it.
24: 
25: ## Loop scope
26: 
27: Separate fresh coder, reviewer and tester processes exchange immutable MCP
28: handoffs. Only coder port-source writes are exposed. Protected tests, loop,
29: engine, WAD and executable build scripts cannot be edited through agent tools.
30: Tester must execute a fresh fixed verification and tie PASS to its source hash.
31: Every configured task must pass; stale completion is invalidated by source changes.
32: Interruptions preserve attempts and reserve unknown cost. Budgets and failure
33: statuses must be explicit. `tests/test_loop.py` exercises these invariants with
34: fixtures; it is not evidence of real autonomous repair or live resumption.
35: 
36: ## Full assignment scope
37: 
38: Independent verification, fault detection, actual autonomous repair of two blind
39: teammate/instructor regressions, resumption, accountability, design rationale and
40: reflection are separate requirements. The user explicitly requested omission of
41: the teammate exercise. Mark it NOT PERFORMED; never convert scoped SUCCESS into
42: full capstone acceptance. Historical token/cost usage remains unknown."}
